subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can scan two reviews quickly to find information.
I can find the good and bad points in a review.
I can use expressions like solve a problem and score points.

tf.s: In TopCity, players are looking for treasure.
tf.why: Yes, the game is about finding treasure in the city.

tf.s: You move around TopCity by writing instructions, like programming a computer.
tf.why: Right, you give instructions to move around the city.

tf.s: GameFan says TopCity is a free game.
tf.why: GameFan says the game isn’t free, but it is good value.

tf.s: MrCool001 learnt to play the game by watching a video.
tf.why: Yes, MrCool001 watched a video to learn how to play.

tf.s: GameFan’s opinion of the game is very positive.
tf.why: GameFan likes the game very much.

tf.s: MrCool001 thinks TopCity is the best programming game of all.
tf.why: MrCool001 thinks there are better programming games.

tf.s: In every building in TopCity, you have to solve a problem.
tf.why: Yes, each building has a problem to solve.

tf.s: A review only tells you the good points about something.
tf.why: A review gives good points and bad points.

tf.s: To scan a text means to read every word slowly.
tf.why: Scanning means looking quickly for the information you need.

tf.s: GameFan says the game was difficult to start playing.
tf.why: GameFan says it was easy to start playing.

boxes.q: What score did GameFan get last night?
Complete: In every building you have to ___ a problem.
Who thinks there are better programming games?
boxes.why: MrCool001 says other programming games are better.

boxes.q: What is a person who writes a review called?
What is MrCool001’s overall opinion of TopCity?
boxes.why: MrCool001 likes it, but not as much as GameFan.

boxes.q: Complete: My brother ___ me tips for the game.
Which word means the pictures in a game?
boxes.why: Graphics are the pictures and images you see.

boxes.q: Complete: I like to ___ online with my friends.
Who says the game was easy to start?
boxes.why: GameFan found it easy to start playing.

o: They help us decide what to buy or play.
boxes.why: Reviews tell us good and bad points before we choose.

hunt.q: What are you looking for in TopCity?
Who learnt by watching a video?

mcq.q: What is GameFan’s bad point about TopCity?
mcq.why: GameFan says it isn’t free, but it is still good value.

mcq.q: How do you move around the city in TopCity?
mcq.why: You write instructions, like programming a computer.

mcq.q: Which expression means “to test yourself with something difficult”?
mcq.why: When you challenge yourself, you try something hard.

mcq.q: What do we call the things a reviewer likes and doesn’t like?
mcq.why: Reviews give good points and bad points.

mcq.q: “My friend tells me how to win the game.” Which expression fits?
mcq.why: When someone tells you how to do better, they give you tips.

mcq.q: You need to find the word “video” in two reviews in one minute. What should you do?
mcq.why: Scanning helps you find a word fast.

o: Most of us play games online at the weekend.
Most of us plays games online at the weekend.
Most of us playing games online at the weekend.
Most of us is play games online at the weekend.
mcq.why: Most of us takes a plural verb: play.

mcq.q: “The game isn’t free, but it’s good value.” What does the reviewer mean?
o: You pay, but it is worth the money.
mcq.why: Good value means it is worth what you pay.

mcq.q: Why is MrCool001’s review quite positive, not very positive?
o: He likes the game but thinks there are better programming games.
He thinks the game is free.
mcq.why: He likes it, but he compares it with better games.

mcq.q: A friend wants a game that makes you think. Which reason from the reviews is best?
o: You solve a problem in every building.
mcq.why: Solving problems makes you think, so this is the best reason.
